name: Of Fleece and Fangs
source:
You're a wolf starving to death after too many failures to secure food.  One night you catch the sight of a feeble lamb sitting in the meadow during the night. Will you converse with it in a meaningless way or will you seek to consume it right away?

[From [url=https://gummyghosting.itch.io/of-fangs-and-fleece]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一只屡次觅食失败、即将饿死的狼。某个夜晚，你看见一只虚弱的羔羊坐在草地上。你会和它聊些无关紧要的话，还是立刻将它吞食？

（摘自[url=https://gummyghosting.itch.io/of-fangs-and-fleece]itch.io[/url]）
